subject: planner, stats: overflow estimation may lead to wrong join reorder (#56752)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (d011ecd7e5). Changes are limited to planner join reorder greedy path and statistics out-of-range estimation: (1) `constructConnectedJoinTree` now falls back to any valid join (and asserts under `intest/enableassert`) when all candidate join costs are non-comparable (Inf/NaN/MaxFloat64), preventing the prior behavior where the greedy solver could incorrectly stop and later build cartesian joins that drop `eqEdges` (i.e., wrong results). (2) `Histogram.OutOfRangeRowCount` returns 0 when `histWidth` overflows to `+Inf`, avoiding NaN/Inf propagation in out-of-range percent math; callers in `pkg/planner/cardinality` add this value as an out-of-range correction. Added an integration test for issue #56704. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in planner/statistics behavior touched here; later upstream history refactors these areas but does not indicate a surviving correctness regression attributable to this commit.
